design.tab_identity: Exact verified native pivot identifiers only; unknown/action entries are retained.
design.filter: Use original pivot items under a verified model lease, recalculate on each setting change, restore on disable and leave native concurrent mutations alone.
design.selection: Use surviving native items, prefer configured start page, retain a known content tab if all are hidden.
design.labels: Reproduce updateTitleAndLayoutForRenderer isIconsOnly branch: nil normal title, hidden label, style 0 and padding 0; preserve native accessibility name and rerun native title logic for restoration.

checkpoints.pivot_checkpoint: native_model_compacted / native_model_already_compacted / restored, or an explicit contract failure
checkpoints.last_content_tab_retained: Safety recovery when all known content tabs are selected for hiding
checkpoints.pivot_removed_selection_recovered: Native selection moved to a surviving tab
checkpoints.native_layout_observed: Final native tab frames, after layout

remaining: Device confirmation of new navigation behavior
